## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what the user can do after this change.

## Validation

List only checks actually run, their result, and whether processes exited naturally. Separate synthetic pages/generated audio from real hardware/service acceptance.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Original text, task/version ownership, explicit copying, and recovery remain safe.
- [ ] No unrequested network call, paid retry, real microphone use, or user-profile migration.
- [ ] No keys, private text/audio, profiles, device/session metadata or local account paths in the diff.
- [ ] Relevant local tests passed; UI changes were viewed with fictional content.
- [ ] Documentation and applicable third-party notices match the change.
- [ ] Unverified items and material risks are stated.
- [ ] No current running application was replaced/restarted and no upload/release was performed by this change.

## Limits or follow-up

Keep planned work distinct from implemented/verified behavior.
